title: Every Day is a Good Day
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating gratitude as a way to transcend external circumstances and find peace in daily life. By letting go of resistance and embracing each day with an attitude of appreciation, we can shift from conflict to openness and create a sense of community. This practice is seen as a key aspect of Buddhist teachings, requiring us to confront and include difficult emotions like bitterness and despair, rather than trying to suppress them.

Give me a phrase about after the full moon.
So Yunmen is one of our ancestors.
